metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: An essential ensemble sitcom that shares the optimistic and wholesome growth seen in Ted Lasso and The Good Place.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, lighthearted police procedural with an ensemble dynamic very similar to Community and New Girl.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A perfect comfort show that blends sharp comedy with a warm, uplifting emotional core similar to Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A gentle and funny family animation that fits perfectly alongside your love for The Simpsons and King of the Hill.

metas.name: Rick and Morty
metas.description: Matches the high-concept sci-fi humor of Futurama and the meta-commentary found in Community.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A classic British sitcom that shares the awkward, eccentric humor found in Peep Show and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: Directed by Edgar Wright, this show is packed with pop-culture references and meta-humor that fans of Community will adore.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary that provides the same kind of absurd, consistent laughs as It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: The quintessential workplace comfort show that matches the easy-watching vibe of Scrubs and New Girl.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Highly dense with jokes and recurring gags, much like the layered writing in Community and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A fun, blue-sky detective comedy with great banter that mirrors the friendship dynamics in Scrubs.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern feel-good workplace sitcom that captures the same heart and humor as Parks and Recreation.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Fast-paced, satirical, and full of cutaway gags, appealing to fans of Futurama and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: A witty adult animation with sharp dialogue and high-stakes comedy for fans of Futurama and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A reliable, lighthearted family mockumentary that is perfect for background viewing or relaxing.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A hilarious and nostalgic look at teen life that matches the chaotic energy and British/Irish wit of Brassic.

metas.name: Letterkenny
metas.description: Fast-talking, wordplay-heavy comedy that fans of the rapid-fire dialogue in It's Always Sunny will appreciate.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: The ultimate comfort reality competition. It’s light, funny, and fits your interest in Gogglebox and British humor.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: An awkward, character-driven British comedy that aligns with the cringe-comedy style of Peep Show.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: Larry David's masterpiece of social awkwardness will appeal to anyone who enjoys Peep Show or It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Incredibly sharp, insult-heavy comedy that matches the cynical brilliance of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A heartwarming and silly ensemble comedy that provides a perfect 'comfort watch' similar to The Good Place.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Set in a video game studio, this shares the tech-sector humor of Silicon Valley and the character growth of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An underrated workplace ensemble comedy that is easy to binge and consistently funny, much like New Girl.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A hidden gem of a corporate satire that matches the quirky, high-concept energy of Dirk Gently and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A high-energy friendship sitcom with rapid-fire jokes similar to the vibe of New Girl and Community.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A sweet, funny, and grounded family sitcom that fits the wholesome side of your watching habits.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy-drama that feels like a live-action version of the spirit found in Futurama.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A quirky sci-fi comedy about an alien trying to fit in, perfect for fans of Fallout and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that focuses on the 'background' crew, mirroring the humor and genre-bending of Futurama.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The peak of low-stakes, comforting background television for when you need to relax completely.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult classic workplace comedy about caterers that matches the cynical but funny tone of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the mind behind Scrubs, it evolved into a wonderful ensemble show about a group of friends who love wine.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A lighthearted, inclusive pirate adventure with a comedic heart similar to Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A dry, musical comedy that fits well with the quirky sensibilities of Peep Show and Master of None.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A classic British sitcom about a grumpy bookstore owner that fans of Peep Show will find hilariously relatable.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: Created by the same author as One-Punch Man, it offers amazing action mixed with a deeply feel-good story.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A chaotic, hilarious friendship comedy that captures the high-energy fun of shows like New Girl and Always Sunny.

metas.name: The Last Man on Earth
metas.description: A unique, high-concept comedy about survival that is surprisingly funny and heartfelt.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliant animated parody of adventure tropes with the same deep lore and humor as Futurama and Community.
